summary: DashBite CUSTOMER app frontend verified end-to-end against the public preview URL. (1) /search filters: filter chip row (search-filters) is visible with an empty query in Restaurants mode; filter-veg narrows restaurant list to pure-veg only — content check: 'Madras Dosa Co.' TRUE, 'Sugar Rush' TRUE, 'Biryani Blues' FALSE as required; filter-sort opens sort-options sheet, sort-option-rating selects and chip relabels to 'Sort: Rating'; filter-clear resets back to search-idle; switching to Dishes mode hides search-filters. (2) Order lifecycle (customer side): login test@dashbite.in -> add Hyderabadi Chicken Biryani from Biryani Blues Kitchen -> cart (proceed-checkout-button) -> checkout, selected saved address via address-card -> payment-option-cod -> place-order-button -> order-confirmation (/order-confirmation?order_id=…) placed as PLACED. Track screen (/track/<id>) shows ETA banner 'Waiting for restaurant · Your order will be accepted shortly' and all 6 timeline steps (track-step-placed/confirmed/preparing/ready/out_for_delivery/delivered) rendered; track-map illustrated web fallback is visible. (3) Partner-API-driven live transitions over the open track screen (no page reload): POST /api/partner/orders/{id}/accept -> banner changes to 'Arriving in ~35 min · Accepted' within ~3s; POST /api/partner/orders/{id}/assign-rider with an available rider (Ravi Kumar) -> rider-card appears with name + 'Bike · KA 01 AB 1234' and rider-call-button + rider-chat-button; POST status=PREPARING -> banner 'Arriving in ~25 min · Preparing'; POST status=READY + 13s wait -> banner 'Arriving in ~7 min · On the way' and rider-marker is visible on the map (simulation drove READY -> OUT_FOR_DELIVERY ~5s after READY). Orders tab 'Active' then shows track-button-<id> for the live order. (4) Closed restaurant & unavailable items: PATCH /api/partner/menu/{id} available=false -> unavailable-<id> row renders on /restaurant/<id>; PATCH /api/partner/restaurant is_open=false -> closed-badge-<rid> appears on /home AND 'Currently closed · not accepting orders' text appears on the restaurant screen; tapping ADD on an available item while closed surfaces the 'currently closed' toast. All partner toggles RESTORED afterwards (is_open=True, unavailable_count=0 verified via API). (5) Live-badge turns 'LIVE' once WebSocket connects. No critical issues; the only minor cosmetic warning is a repeated web console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' (from menu-item-row + orders cards). All requested test IDs are present and correctly wired.

issues: React Native Web console warning (non-blocking): 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. Several components (menu-item-row addBtn/stepper, orders list card) still set shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset which trigger this warning on web. Native shadow still works but console noise should be cleaned by moving to boxShadow (web) + elevation (android) or using a Platform.select wrapper.

action_items: (Minor cosmetic) Replace shadow* style props with boxShadow on web (menu-item-row.tsx addBtn/stepper, orders.tsx cards) to clear repeated console deprecation warning. Non-functional — shadows still render.

(Nice-to-have) When Track screen is opened directly after an order-confirmation screen, the status banner briefly flashes 'Arriving in ~35 min · Connecting...' before the WebSocket init message arrives (observed when status is PLACED but ETA label resolves from STATUS_LABELS['PLACED']='Placed'). The PLACED-specific banner handling is already present in track/[id].tsx (lines 157-161) so this works correctly after init — just worth a sanity re-check if E1 ever reorders the status handling.
critical_code_review_comments: search.tsx (lines 150-194) correctly keeps the filter chip row mounted in Restaurants mode and hides it in Dishes mode; filter-clear only shown when filtersActive — matches spec.

track/[id].tsx WebSocket re-connect logic (lines 42-72) is correct with closed-flag + 4s retry + cleanup. All 6 statuses are mapped to timeline steps and have specific ETA-banner handling (PLACED, PAYMENT_PENDING, CANCELLED, DELIVERED).
live-map.web.tsx interpolates rider between restaurant and destination with reanimated — rider-marker testID is correctly gated on showRider.
menu-item-row.tsx disables the Pressable + swaps ADD -> 'Unavailable' pill with testID unavailable-<id> when item.available === false. Good.
restaurant-card.tsx renders closed-badge-<id> + 55% opacity image when is_open === false. Good.
order/[id].tsx cancel window: canCancel gated on CANCELLABLE statuses + 60s. Platform.OS==='web' uses window.confirm. Good.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (search filters, full order placement, track live via partner-driven WebSocket, rider card, map, orders Active, unavailable items, closed restaurant toast + home badge + restaurant screen message)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Customer login testIDs are login-email-input / login-password-input / login-submit-button (NOT email-input/submit-button). Cart proceed button is proceed-checkout-button. Checkout address tile (checkout-address-tile) is navigational: tapping it goes to /address — do NOT tap it after an address is already selected; just tap it, pick an address-card-<id>, which navigates back to checkout automatically. Payment option is payment-option-cod. Place order is place-order-button. After place, URL is /order-confirmation?order_id=<id> (NOT /track/<id> directly); regex should include query-string: /(?:track|order|order-confirmation).*?([a-f0-9]{24})/ or parse the query param. Partner-driven lifecycle timings confirmed: READY+rider -> ~5s -> OUT_FOR_DELIVERY -> ~60s -> DELIVERED. Live-badge connects via WS /api/ws/orders/<id> (customer side) typically within ~3s. search-filters is a container testID — assertions should be on is_visible of that container plus the 3 fixed chips (filter-sort/filter-veg/filter-rating). All closed/unavailable testIDs are closed-badge-<rid> and unavailable-<item_id>.
